title: Scaffold a project's in-package documentation
description: Creates <projectRoot>/docs/index.md pre-filled from the project's package.json. Docs LIVE in the package; config-generator + sync-docs assemble them into the site.

project.x-prompt: Which project do you want to document?

category.description: Docs category (sidebar group). Adds a `doc:<category>` tag to the project so config-generator files its docs under that group. Omit to tag it yourself later.
category.x-prompt: Which docs category? (sidebar group, e.g. client, shared, plugins, ops)
